{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: only completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter: exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
valid_df = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute average revenue per completed order by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = valid_df.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Compute average revenue per completed order by channel and customer_segment
avg_revenue_by_channel_segment = valid_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Display the cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment
print('Average revenue per completed order by channel and customer segment:')
print(avg_revenue_by_channel_segment)

# Check if the email channel has higher revenue in each segment
email_higher_in_all = (avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['email'] > avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['paid_search']).all()
print(f'Email channel higher than paid_search in all segments: {email_higher_in_all}')}}
